partition.case_order: walking-v1 acceptance commands in committed order, then start populations in committed order, then derived seeds in index order

beacon.timing_rule: pulse timestamp must be strictly later than immutable candidate freeze timestamp

derivation.input: protocol_id NUL candidate_sha256 NUL beacon_output NUL uint64_be(counter)
derivation.seed_mapping: first 8 digest bytes big-endian modulo 2147483646 plus 1; skip duplicates and any public development or public acceptance seed
derivation.realized_initial_state: use walking-v1 seed_handling sha256-counter-v1 after held-out seed derivation

realization_preconditions: candidate artifact and source manifest are immutable and digest-bound
candidate freeze attestation timestamp precedes beacon pulse timestamp
no candidate execution or tuning occurs between freeze and realization
evidence_boundary: This preregisters a blinded held-out realization protocol only. No beacon, held-out seed, case, policy result, or task success has been realized.
